summary: AI-powered web scraping and browser automation has shifted from brittle CSS-selector scripts toward LLM-driven extraction, natural-language queries, and agent-controlled headless browsers. Tools like Firecrawl, Apify, and Playwright now dominate developer adoption by combining clean markdown/JSON output, cloud browser infrastructure, and integrations with RAG pipelines and AI agents. The leaders cluster around robustness, maintainability, and the ability to feed structured data directly to models.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; costs only arise from hosting/cloud browser providers
ai_features: Integrates with AI agents via MCP and browser automation frameworks
Used as the execution layer for many LLM-driven scraping/agent tools
Codegen and auto-waiting reduce need for manual selectors
strengths: Massive GitHub star count and community adoption
Reliable auto-waiting and modern async API
tools.best_for: General-purpose browser automation and dynamic-site scraping, often as the foundation for AI agents

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited credits; paid plans start around $16-$19/mo scaling to enterprise
ai_features: LLM-ready markdown and structured JSON output
Lovable integration to build scraping workflows with natural language
Crawl, scrape, and search endpoints optimized for RAG
strengths: Clean, model-ready output out of the box
Handles JS-heavy sites and crawling at scale
Strong developer momentum and open-source core
tools.best_for: Feeding clean web content into LLM/RAG pipelines with minimal setup

tools.name: Apify
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with $5 monthly usage credit; paid plans from $49/mo plus usage-based pricing
ai_features: Integrations with LLM frameworks and agents
strengths: Large Actor marketplace for ready-made scrapers
Scales extraction and crawling in the cloud
tools.best_for: Large-scale, production extraction and reusable scraping workflows

tools.name: Browserbase
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited sessions; paid plans start around $20/mo with usage-based scaling
ai_features: Headless browser infrastructure for AI agents
Stagehand framework for natural-language browser control
Session recording and observability for agent debugging
strengths: Managed cloud browsers built for agents
Growing adoption among AI web-agent builders
tools.best_for: Running production AI web agents that need reliable cloud browsers

tools.name: Bright Data
tools.pricing_paid: Free trial; pay-as-you-go and subscription plans, typically starting around $0.001/request scaling to enterprise
ai_features: AI-powered Web Scraper APIs and datasets
Structured data extraction with ready-made collectors
tools.best_for: Enterprise-scale extraction requiring robust proxies and anti-bot bypass

tools.name: ScrapeGraphAI
tools.pricing_paid: Open-source library is free; hosted API with free credits and paid plans from around $20/mo
ai_features: Works with multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, local models)
strengths: Define scraping logic in plain language
tools.best_for: Developers wanting prompt-driven, open-source LLM scraping pipelines

tools.name: Browse.ai
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited credits; paid plans start around $19/mo scaling with tasks
strengths: Fast to configure for simple sites
tools.best_for: No-code users monitoring and extracting data from specific sites

tools.name: AgentQL
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with monthly query allowance; paid plans start around $99/mo
ai_features: AI-resilient selectors that survive layout changes
Structured data extraction via query language
strengths: Selectors defined by intent rather than CSS/XPath
Integrates with Playwright and automation stacks
tools.best_for: Building durable scrapers and agents that resist UI changes

tools.name: Diffbot
tools.pricing_paid: Free trial; paid plans start around $299/mo for API access and Knowledge Graph
ai_features: Knowledge Graph of structured web entities
strengths: Strong for article and product data
tools.best_for: Structured knowledge extraction and large-scale entity data

tools.name: Octoparse
tools.pricing_paid: Free plan with limited tasks; paid plans start around $99/mo
strengths: Visual no-code desktop and cloud scraping
tools.best_for: No-code visual scraping for business and research users

tools.name: Stagehand
tools.pricing_paid: Open source and free; runs on Browserbase (paid) or local browsers
ai_features: Combines deterministic Playwright code with AI steps
strengths: Blends code reliability with AI flexibility
Good for resilient AI web agents
tools.best_for: Developers building AI web agents mixing code and natural-language steps

tools.name: Crawl4AI
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; self-hosted (infrastructure costs only)
strengths: Very high GitHub star count and community traction
Designed specifically for AI/LLM data pipelines
tools.best_for: Self-hosted, open-source crawling to feed LLMs and RAG systems
